name: MK Santa Maria Full Size Ash Wood Acrylic Keyboard Display
displayName: Santa Maria Full Size Ash Wood Acrylic
sourceText:
Crafted from real Ash wood and thick transparent acrylic.
Minimilastic design showcases your keyboard while taking up very little space.
Keyholes in the back and included mounting hardware for wall mounting.
464x145x55mm interior fits most standard full size keyboards (permanent USB cords may require case modification)
Low profile felt bottom to prevent scratching on desk surface.
The MK Team wanted to display some of our treasured boards without ruining the aesthetics with a dust cover. We searched far and wide and found nothing worthy, so we created it.
The "Santa Maria" is the largest of MK's three new displays and is designed to elegantly showcase most standard full-size keyboards. The thick Ash wood used to construct the base offers a beautiful but subtle shine while the thick transparent acrylic cover shields your keyboard from dust and tempted fingers. We like our displays like we like our keyboards - heavy. This display is solid and built to last.
Want to fill your walls with keyboards? Just find a stud or make use of the badass sheetrock anchors (cheap anchors are evil) we threw in the box. We made sure you can safely mount the Santa Maria in the perfect spot without having to make a trip to Home Depot.
